lines.label: B1
lines.reason: This is a real sharp fold of about 24 deg, between the top tab (patch 12) and the short straight strip (patch 11). In sections at 25/50/75% the label sits on the convex (outer, -x side) skin corner. The nearest scan point is 0.01-0.19 mm away at every 3 mm station from z=-76 to -10, and the label is the outermost point along the bisector. The tool's apex offset is 0.16 mm against 0.07 mm expected. The line runs parallel to the fold (direction ~ +z) and covers the whole length where both plates exist, 68.9 of 68.9 mm. The only scan points past the start are the tab corner beyond the notch, which is not part of the fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: This is a real reverse kink of about 18 deg (above 15 deg), between the straight strip and where the roll starts (patch 15 / patch 3). It forms an S with the roll: the strip sits inward of the roll's tangent, so this is a real corner and not a tangent run-out. In zoomed sections at 25/50/75% the label sits on the convex (+x) skin corner. The nearest scan point is 0.03-0.37 mm away at every station, and the label is the outermost point along the bisector. The line is parallel and spans the full 68.8 mm of the fold, as seen face-on and in obliques.
